mentions.name: blockwatch
mentions.description: A cross-file deterministic drift checker that keeps related parts of code, configs, and docs in sync. Source code is annotated with special rules (either in source code comments or a blockwatch.toml config file) that configure how parts of the code depend on each other. It uses tree-sitter to parse source code and supports 35+ languages.
mentions.problem: In large codebases that share constants across programming languages and configs, and where docs should strictly reflect the current state of the code, these cross-file dependencies can silently drift out of sync.
